adjustment.analysis: The baseline median is 95.8. No events, promotions, or price changes are scheduled. The heatwave forecast (38°C) is a known driver. Historical data shows no prior heatwave effect, but recent weeks (2026-08-03 to 2026-08-24) during back-to-school season saw 106–127 units (vs baseline 95.8), a 10–32% lift. The heatwave is a stronger driver than seasonality. With only one prior heatwave occurrence (no data), the noise-adjusted effect is shrunk toward 1.0. A moderate 15% uplift is justified, with high uncertainty. The classical model suggests no lift, but it ignores weather. No downward drivers present.
